description: This file defines the GatewaySession class along with related data classes, enums, and functions to manage WebSocket-based communication with a gateway server. It handles connection establishment, message parsing, request/response handling, event management, and authentication flows within an Android environment.

classes.name: GatewayClientInfo
classes.description: Data class representing information about a gateway client, including ID, display name, version, platform, mode, instance ID, device family, and model identifier.

classes.name: GatewayConnectOptions
classes.description: Data class defining connection options such as role, scopes, capabilities, commands, permissions, and client info.

classes.name: GatewayConnectErrorDetails
classes.description: Contains details about connection errors, including error code, whether a retry with device token is possible, and a recommended next step.

classes.name: SelectedConnectAuth
classes.description: Represents selected authentication credentials and source during connection setup, including retry attempt status.

classes.name: GatewaySession
classes.description: Main class managing WebSocket sessions with the gateway, including connection lifecycle, message handling, request/response management, and authentication flows.

classes.name: GatewaySession.InvokeRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request to invoke a command on the gateway, including ID, node ID, command, parameters, and timeout.

classes.name: GatewaySession.InvokeResult
classes.description: Data class representing the result of an invocation, indicating success, payload, or error.

classes.name: GatewaySession.ErrorShape
classes.description: Data class detailing error shape with code, message, and optional details.

classes.name: GatewaySession.Connection
classes.description: Inner class representing an active WebSocket connection, handling messaging, request/response, and connection lifecycle.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates a connection to the gateway with specified endpoint and credentials.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the current gateway connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: reconnect
methods.description: Triggers reconnection logic, closing the current connection to attempt re-establishment.

methods.name: sendNodeEvent
methods.description: Sends an event related to a node to the gateway.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a request to the gateway with specified method, parameters, and timeout, returning the response.

methods.name: refreshNodeCanvasCapability
methods.description: Requests a refresh of the node's canvas capability and updates the stored URL.
